brief.label: ATM dogfooding coverage gate
brief.summary: 建立 Framework Function Atomization Manifest 與 coverage gate，證明 ATM framework Layer 2 功能都有 atom / map / adapter facade 或正式例外。
brief.prereq: ATM-2-0038 / ATM-2-0041 / ATM-2-0042 已承接 AtomGenerator / MapGenerator / provenance；ATM-3-0015 只覆蓋 task card system atomic map

input: Layer 1 constitutional schema 只要求 hash-lock / migration gate，不要求自我 atom
Layer 2 governed framework functions must have atom / atomic map / governed adapter facade coverage
Layer 3 mutable host config 只要求 git / adapter config 管理，不列入必須原子化
Existing cards must be reused; do not duplicate generator / task-card / gate-map work
ATM-3-0015 covers only task card lifecycle, not the whole framework
不清楚的功能邊界需回查 docs/ai_atomic_framework/ 規劃書，不以任務卡 notes 片段自行推斷完成
output: 盤點 CLI / spec / scaffold / registry / test / evidence / police / adapter / task lifecycle / map / PEV 等 framework functions
每個 Layer 2 function 至少對應 atom / atomic map / adapter facade / open task
Layer 1 只能標 constitutional-exception；Layer 3 只能標 mutable-exception
已由既有卡承接的功能必須引用原卡，不重複開功能卡
新增 validator，當 framework function 缺 atom / map / adapter coverage 或例外類型錯誤時 fail
回寫規劃文件，讓 all framework functions atomized 有 coverage gate
把 ATM-2-0048 -> ATM-3-0015 -> ATM-2-0050 固定路線寫成正式 gate 條文，供後續開卡引用
文件治理政策與現況角色盤點完成，明確標示 canonical / reference / adopter / history / index / shard / asset
validate-atm-doc-governance 能檢查 root files / shard dirs / Agent Boot Order，防止新增文件平行長出第二份主真相
contracts.validation_cmd:
npm.cmd run check:encoding:touched -- --files docs/agent-briefs/tasks/ATM/ATM-2-0050.md docs/tasks/tasks-atm/tasks-atm-part-24.json docs/ai_atomic_framework/framework-function-atomization-manifest.md docs/ai_atomic_framework/AI_Atomic_Framework_Roadmap.md docs/ai_atomic_framework/AI原子框架開發計畫書.md docs/ai_atomic_framework/ATM框架演進執行規劃書.md docs/ai_atomic_framework/關於進化版的原子提案.md docs/ai_atomic_framework/documentation-governance-policy.md docs/ai_atomic_framework/documentation-role-map.md
node tools_node/validate-framework-atomization-coverage.js --manifest docs/ai_atomic_framework/framework-function-atomization-manifest.md
node tools_node/validate-atm-doc-governance.js --root docs/ai_atomic_framework --strict
node tools_node/doc-id-registry.js
contracts.rollback_hint: 移除 coverage manifest、validator、planning docs backwrite，並保留既有 ATM-2-0038 / ATM-2-0041 / ATM-2-0042 / ATM-3-0015 的功能範圍不變。
execution_steps: 盤點所有 ATM framework task cards 與 planning docs，先歸併到既有功能卡
定義 Layer 1 / Layer 2 / Layer 3 邊界與 coverage statuses
先確認 ATM-2-0048 與 ATM-3-0015 的固定路線是否已滿足前置條件
建立 framework function coverage manifest
將缺口連到既有 open 卡或 follow-up，不重複開已存在功能
回寫 Roadmap / 開發計畫書 / 演進規劃書 / 進化版原子提案 / task shard
建立文件治理政策與現況角色盤點，先完成邏輯收斂，再安排後續 physical reorganization
Agent Boot Order 固定為 documentation-governance-policy -> documentation-role-map -> ATM_cross_reference -> canonical owner
